purpose: Public-only compatibility and German temporal-grounding screen before any restricted ChildLens packet discovery.

input.expansion: Nearest-neighbor repetition of the five ordered source frames only; no generated intermediate visual content.
input.visual_style: Self-generated 512x512 vector scenes with common objects and actions; no external or restricted media.

prompt: Give you a textual query: '<GERMAN_QUERY>'. When does the described content occur in the video? Return exactly one line using one of these forms: 'From <start> seconds to <end> seconds.', 'NOT_VISIBLE', or 'AMBIGUOUS'.

output_schema.pre_schema_canonicalization: Apply the authors' deterministic <0..300> temporal-token-to-seconds conversion for a 10-second clip, format to two decimals, strip leading/trailing whitespace, and collapse repeated internal whitespace. No lexical rewriting or answer extraction is permitted.

lag_mapping.lead: Parsed end is less than 4.0 seconds.
lag_mapping.overlap: Parsed interval intersects the closed 4.0-to-6.0-second anchor band.
lag_mapping.lag: Parsed start is greater than 6.0 seconds.
lag_mapping.ambiguous_boundary: Any present interval not assigned by the three rules above.

cases.query_de: der rote Ball rollt nach rechts
die Hand hebt den gelben Würfel an

failure: Stop without restricted packet discovery, prompt repair, retry, translation, or model substitution.
